name: Journey to the Crossroads
summary: At Camp Taurajo, Kirge Sternhorn sends travelers north to aid Thork at the Crossroads. The journey carries them from Mulgore into the Barrens and the wider struggles of the Horde.

sections.title: Leaving the Cradle
sections.body: Camp Taurajo is where many tauren first face the Barrens beyond Mulgore. Just past the mountain pass, mystic Kirge Sternhorn watches travelers descend into the dry grasslands. When Sternhorn sees that a traveler is ready to go farther, Kirge points north along the dusty trade route toward the Crossroads.

sections.title: A Shared Bond
sections.body: The tauren of Thunder Bluff and Thrall's new Horde now share their fortunes. Kirge says the two peoples' fates are bound together, and orcs at the Crossroads need reinforcements as they struggle to establish an outpost. At the settlement, Thork welcomes travelers from even the high bluffs, ready to test their strength against the dangers of the savanna.

faq.q: Who starts Journey to the Crossroads?
faq.answer: Kirge Sternhorn, a tauren mystic at Camp Taurajo, sends travelers north. The camp lies in the southern Barrens, just east of the mountain pass from Mulgore.
Thork is inside the stockade walls at the Crossroads, the Horde settlement in the central Barrens. It lies north of Camp Taurajo along the main road.

faq.q: Why does Kirge Sternhorn send travelers to the Crossroads?
faq.answer: Kirge Sternhorn sees that a traveler is ready for greater trials and knows tauren and orcs now share an intertwined fate. The orcish garrison at the Crossroads faces constant pressure from local threats and needs capable allies.

The Crossroads is the Horde's main strategic hub and trading post in central Kalimdor. Major north-south and east-west trails meet there, and the settlement is a base for bringing order to the wild frontier.

faq.q: Do only tauren receive this task?
faq.answer: Yes. Kirge Sternhorn sends only tauren on this journey, welcoming kin from as far as Thunder Bluff and directing them to report to Thork.

faq.q: What threats await along the road to the Crossroads?
faq.answer: The road north crosses dry plains where aggressive plainstriders, prowling savanna lions, and roaming bands of Razormane quilboar roam. Keeping to the beaten path helps travelers avoid the more territorial predators of the central savanna.

angles.text: As a tauren, you leave the shelter of the Earthmother's sacred mesa and enter the wider struggles of the Horde.
As an orc, you know Thork needs reinforcements from the south to hold the ground Thrall's scouts have secured across the Barrens.
As a member of the Horde, you see cooperation grow between the tribes of Thunder Bluff and the warchief's vanguard in central Kalimdor.
